findings.issue: Two sample pending plans gave a NEGATIVE result for the POSITIVE input 0.5: (SS,EN12.3E2) -> '-500.000E-03' and (SS,ES12.3E2) -> '  -5.000E-01'. SS suppresses the optional plus sign, so for a positive value the sign position must be BLANK.
findings.correct_values: (SS,EN12.3E2) 0.5 -> ' 500.000E-03' - EN uses a multiple-of-three exponent giving 500.000E-03, 11 characters, one leading blank. (SS,ES12.3E2) 0.5 -> '   5.000E-01' - ES uses exactly one leading digit giving 5.000E-01, 9 characters, three leading blanks.
findings.why_blocking: These plans are the specification every future numeric-format fixture executes from. A wrong expected string does not stay in the catalogue - it is faithfully implemented as a test asserting the wrong bytes, and then looks authoritative. A PRECISE BUT WRONG plan is worse than a vague one, which is why batch136 was blocked for vagueness in the first place.
findings.closure: Closed in 18d60e4, with a sweep of 66 numeric-output entries finding these two across four catalogue occurrences.
findings.verification: Hand-derived by the integrator, corroborated with gfortran 16.1.0 -std=f2023, then independently re-derived by the reviewer from the source.

findings.issue: ELEVEN units mixing an obligation with a grant of latitude were dispositioned wholly as permission. Examples: 13.7.1 p4 says Unicode output characters ARE of ISO 10646 kind and then separately grants latitude for unrepresentable characters; 13.7.2.4 p4 says input editing PRODUCES INT(X), REAL(X) or ET(INT(X)).
findings.recurring_class: FOURTH occurrence this session - batch123 in 11.7.2 and 11.7.5, batch136 in 13.2.2 p2, and here. The pattern is always identical: a unit contains both an obligation and latitude, and is classified by its more memorable half, leaving the obligation with no facet and nothing downstream to test it.
findings.closure: Closed in 79caa9f. All eleven re-dispositioned to requirements with the latitude confined to rationale and oracle text: 13.7.1 p4; F p3/p6/p10; Tables 13.1/13.2/13.3; EX p2/p5; rounding p3; BOZ p4. Only 13.5 p3 remains permission, for its 'can cause' stream positioning.
findings.mirror_risk_checked: The reviewer specifically verified that reclassifying to requirements does not now assert the LATITUDE half as an obligation - the mirror defect that the sibling 13.10-13.11 packet had to be checked for.
